svg.title: Labelling and training workflow
svg.desc: The taxonomy came from labelling 338 discovery clusters. Candidates were assigned, exported with a blind test sheet, labelled by two people and resolved. The labels were cleaned, agreement measured, and FinBERT fine-tuned over three seeds and evaluated against baselines. An LLM aspect classifier and re-scoring the corpus are planned.
